task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick the box holding playing cards and slide it further outward.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。机械臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架拾取装有扑克牌的盒子并进一步向外滑动。
